name: Makina
fix_description: Add access control to updateTotalAum (restrict to keeper/owner) or add a time delay so the updated AUM cannot be consumed in the same block. Root cause: lastTotalAum is the share-price anchor and any user can refresh it mid-tx from spot-priced positions. Attacker flash-loans 280M USDC to skew Curve pool balances, calls updateTotalAum() to bake manipulated state into accounting, then swaps DUSD at inflated share price.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC requires a fairly intricate multi-protocol attack chain: large-scale Curve liquidity manipulations across multiple pools, protocol-specific state updates in Caliber/Machine, and repeating the sequence to maximize profit. Writing it demands deep understanding of Makina’s accounting/AUM logic plus custom instruction encoding and merkle-proof-based position updates, which pushes it well beyond a straightforward flash-loan exploit.
